column2: intro]
When I see a photo or a painting so grand,
My mind takes flight, it’s part of my plan.
I remember every tiny little part,
As if a camera’s inside my heart.
I have a visual memory, so eclectic,
Remembering details, it’s almost magic.
In my mind, everything glows in pastel,
My visual memory, it’s truly special.
I recall each stranger’s face I’ve met,
Even years later, they’re not forgotten yet.
The paths I’ve walked, the landscapes I’ve seen,
In my visual memory, all is kept pristine.
I have a visual memory, so eclectic,
Remembering details, it’s almost magic.
In my mind, everything glows in pastel,
My visual memory, it’s truly special.
[ solo ]
So if you want to recall those precious times,
Open your eyes and let life’s colors shine.
For my visual memory is here to share,
With a touch of magic, forever there.
[outro]
